note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-22 after Router Key (type 9) handling was added to RTRSession.handlePDU. RFC 6810 Section 6.3 requires that on Cache Reset, if there are no more preferred caches, the router MUST issue a Reset Query and get an entire new load from the cache in protocol version 0. Current handlePDU still rejects a version-0 Cache Reset before entering its pduCacheReset branch (rtrVersionMin=1), rejects version-0 downgrade in its code-4 branch, and syncOnce retries only versions 1 through 2. Adding pduRouterKey staging does not reach version-0 Cache Reset recovery. No test carries this id; the declared version-0 gap remains unimplemented.
